headline.en: Backend Developer · API integration and ERP data migration

about.pt: Desenvolvedor backend com foco em integração de APIs e migração de dados entre ERPs. Trabalho com Python, JavaScript, TypeScript e SQL, construo APIs REST com Node.js, Express e Prisma, desenvolvo em Frappe/ERPNext e uso React no front-end. Aqui estão os projetos que criei e os projetos em equipe em que contribuí.
about.en: Backend developer focused on API integration and data migration between ERPs. I work with Python, JavaScript, TypeScript and SQL, build REST APIs with Node.js, Express and Prisma, develop on Frappe/ERPNext and use React on the front end. Here are the projects I've built and the team projects I've contributed to.
